comments.text: Bug: the update method reads the 'detector_type' key, but the field is named 'type'. Suggested fix: read validated_data.get('type', ...) instead.
get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title(title) rather than using the max_length parameter from its own signature, which would be more consistent.
The mutual-exclusion checks between age and timestamp handle both W3C spec versions, but both fields are optional, so a report with neither would pass. Suggests requiring at least one.
Style: the loop returns a 422 for the whole batch if any single report fails serializer validation. Suggests partial success (process valid reports, log invalid ones) may be more resilient.
Style: error_events is sorted in place, which could cause issues if the list is reused elsewhere. Suggests using sorted() to build a new list.
